title.narrative: Developing Resources and Empowering Communities (DeREC) for Improved Food Security and Enhanced Nature & Community-focused Tourism

description.narrative:
Overall objective: Improving the food security and nutritional status and hygiene practices of 5,000 vulnerable plantation worker households and households in the surrounding communities in the Central and Uva provinces affected due to COVID-19 and the resultant economic crisis. The 5,000 households targeted under this proposal are additional to the 50,000 households covered under the RTU project. The proposed households will be a different target group to be covered from the same DS divisions and districts as in the earlier project, but who have not directly benefitted from the RTU project

This is a consolidated programme to negate the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic among the communities through Improved Food, Hygiene and Nutritional Security and Promote Nature and Community-Focused Tourism through Inclusive Transformation of MSME Businesses and Local Communities.
